apps.author: Medard22
apps.name: Dolphin-MMJR2-VBI
apps.changeLog:
Notable changes from U24.03.22-21259

- Code refactoring and minor fixes
- Fixed a panic alert for Def Jam: Fight for New York and Fifa Street
- Numerous small optimizations to JitARM64
- Small optimizations to DSP HLE audio decoding
- Fixed stuttering from JIT Cache clear - mostly notable in Shadow the Hedgehog
- Set OSD message color to yellow in default AMOLED theme
- Updated Vulkan Memory Allocator and Vulkan Headers
- Updated and optimized app icons

Missing features - these features from Dolphin Official are not implemented

- Android Input Overhaul and subsequent changes to Input and TAS handling
- Custom GPU driver support
- Skylanders portal and Infinity base support
- Gamma correction

This codebase is based on the Official Dolphin dev build 2407-1 (Jul 2, 2024). For more information about what has changed check the PR history. 

**General information**
- When I started this project, my only goal was to add the VBI Skip hack to MMJR2. At the time, I had little to no coding experience and knew nothing about Git, GitHub, or Android Studio. Looking back to 2023, I never imagined I’d come this far.
- Fast forward almost a year and a half later—with over 1,100 pull requests—I’ve managed to update this codebase from Dolphin 5.0-18205 (December 2022) all the way to Dolphin 2407 (July 2024). Of course, all the credit goes to the Dolphin Team, since they did the real heavy lifting. My job has simply been figuring out how to make it all work in MMJR2.
- I work on this fork in my free time, mostly for myself, but I’m genuinely happy that so many of you find it useful. The previous release has been downloaded over 150,000 times and that is honestly mind-blowing. 
- I’ll keep working to improve MMJR2 for as long as I’m able. Thank you all for your support! 
- **Android developers willing to help are welcome!**

**Caution**
- **Save states from older versions are, unfortunately, NOT compatible with this release. Be sure to make an in-game save before updating!**

**Known Issues**
- The UI in the Cheats section is broken when you try to delete multiple items in a row. This bug is present to this day in Dolphin Official. Just delete a few items, exit the cheats window, and return back.
- For people using touch controls. It is possible that the core controls and touchscreen controls get out of sync. For more information check here - [https://github.com/Medard22/Dolphin-MMJR2-VBI/discussions/708](https://github.com/Medard22/Dolphin-MMJR2-VBI/discussions/708)

apps.author: Trixarian
apps.name: NetherSX2 Classic
apps.changeLog:
Merry Christmas, Happy Holidays and a Happy New Year everyone!

This update adds experimental Online Multiplayer to NetherSX2 along with the usual updates!
Thanks to [IamLupo](https://github.com/IamLupo) for adding it to ARMSX2, and [zakilj3](https://www.youtube.com/user/zakilj3) for discovering the same settings work with NetherSX2!

[VirusTotal Scan Report](https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/8b502b31ce797d5a162bc6b9300b5f02351b0b6b290b8dc1390b8dfb826673ab)

## How to use Online Multiplayer
1. Go to your App Settings --> Settings and toggle on Enable DEV9 Ethernet
2. Set API to Sockets, and Device to how you want to connect online with the default being WiFi. Set this to VPN if your phone uses a VPN, and to one of the two SIM DATA options if you want to use your Mobile Data Plan instead
3. That should be enough to get you online using a guide like [this](https://youtu.be/dcOnZzzcbSc?si=WOf01r0Ln5ZVQkpf&t=278) by LogicalMacrochip

You can use the [Official List of PlayStation 2 Online Games (2024)](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15pfhL36qmC-iKr8MNjNXNLwgacG4VOmkfvwVxV5vGzo/edit?gid=0#gid=0) to figure out what games work, get their DNAS bypass codes if needed and which private server you should be using

For more advanced options (or you want to use the second method from the guide by LogicalMacrochip), you can do the following:
1. Set DNS1 Mode to Manual
2. Under DNS1 select either  [PS2 Online](https://ps2online.com) (called Cristian in the Official list) or [PSRewired](https://psrewired.com)
Note: This can also be changed on a Per Game Settings and more servers will be added soon
To turn it off just set DNS1 Mode to Auto and DNS1 to 0.0.0.0

[zakilj3](https://www.youtube.com/user/zakilj3) created a more [comprehensive guide](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uZzEXvNXUUU) to make it easier for people

apps.author: ARMSX2
apps.name: ARMSX2
apps.changeLog:
### ARMSX2 1.0.8 Stable Changelog

ARMSX2 1.0.8 is now available as the latest stable release. This update brings major compatibility, graphics, performance, and usability improvements, with the biggest focus being vastly improved Mali GPU support from all the nighties since 1.0.6.

**Major Mali GPU Improvements**

Mali support has been significantly improved in ARMSX2 1.0.8. Mali users no longer need to rely on a separate Mali-specific build to benefit from recent graphics fixes and compatibility improvements. These fixes are now included directly in the main ARMSX2 build.

This update should improve the experience on Mali devices by reducing graphics issues, improving OpenGL behavior, and making more games playable or stable on affected hardware.

For testing on some Mali devices, users may need to set Blending to Maximum and disable Show GPU on Stats to avoid a black screen. This was tested on a Redmi 9 Prime with a Mali G52 MC2/MP2 GPU.

Please let us know whether these changes improve your experience on Mali devices. You can join our discord to connect with us! [https://discord.gg/KwAChKDctz](url)

**OpenGL Renderer Improvements**

The GL renderer has received major improvements, especially for devices affected by rendering bugs. These changes should improve both performance and compatibility across supported Android devices, with Mali devices seeing some of the most important benefits.

**HostFS Support**

This latest update also includes HostFS support, allowing supported homebrew and development workflows to access files from the host device more easily.

**VU1 Emulation Improvements**

VU1 emulation has also been improved. Games such as the GTA series should now play as expected, and other games affected by similar VU1-related issues may also be fixed.

**New Features**

- Added GPU Profile Override setting.
- Added support for disc swapping.
- Added FPS limit / framerate control.
- Added new internal resolution scale options: 0.25x, 0.5x, and 0.75x.
- Added a new on-screen display / OSD.
- Added support for creating memory cards from 8 MB to 64 MB.
- Added support for folder memory cards.
- Added a new option to disable unsafe OSD warnings.
- Added CHD cover support.
- Improved PNACH cheat importing so imported files are automatically renamed to the game’s serial CRC.
- Added automatic // handling when importing PNACH files.
- Fixed PNACH Android data location behavior, allowing cheats to be saved where the user wants.
- Fixed Fast Boot.
- Fixed Instant VU being disabled while MTVU is enabled.
- Fixed the Trilinear OSD bug.
- Fixed a fullscreen UI bug.
- Fixed a memory card section issue in the sw600dp layout.
- Included the latest fullscreen UI fix in the stable release.
- Boot Logo Update

ARMSX2 now includes an updated boot logo with sound, created by @Vivimagic and audio done by @jpolo1224. 

**Credits**

Huge thanks to @DIB1998 for the major Mali, OpenGL, OSD, resolution scale, memory card, disc swapping, FPS limit, and graphics-related improvements.

Thanks also to @momo-AUX1 for extensive bug fixing, new settings, and helping bring the Mali fixes into the main ARMSX2 build.

Thank you to @Vivimagic for the new ARMSX2 boot logo, and credits to (NASA/CXC/SAO/K.Arcand, SYSTEM Sounds (M. Russo, A. Santaguida) for the sound used as well. The 1987A Supernova Sonification just screams PS2. Also, to everyone testing nightly builds and reporting issues, as well as the rest of the ARMSX2 team for their continued contributions.

apps.name: Argosy Launcher
apps.changeLog:
## New Features
- Saves migrate between emulators on launch.
- PS2 folder memory card picker: when multiple folder cards exist, pick which one Argosy syncs from. Settings exposes the selection; ambiguous setups prompt at launch.

## Improvements
- PSP save handling: per-game folders correctly identified by serial prefix (handles installed-game-data folders properly).
- Built-in cores keep playing offline when the core file is already on disk.
- Press Left at the leftmost UI boundary to open the nav drawer.
- Hardcore-trailer mismatch no longer reported as "Download failed".

## Bug Fixes
- Save sync refuses to wipe a folder memcard parent when the title-id scope finds no matches (prevents data loss across other games).
- Built-in PPSSPP foreground service uses the real package name for activity monitoring.
